summary.headline: Planetary Cycles and Sign Durations
summary.text: Discussion of planetary cycles and sign durations: the Moon’s roughly 27⅓-day cycle, Saturn’s nearly 30-year cycle, Jupiter’s nearly 12-year cycle, Mars’s roughly 22-month cycle, and the faster cycles of Venus and Mercury. The author explains the approximate figures by variations in planetary speed, unequal stays in signs, and distinctions between mean and true cycles.
